capabilities: Color graph nodes by folder depth as a two-color gradient
Apply the gradient per top-level folder section with dynamic depth ranges
Refresh node colors when the vault changes
Color nodes in both the global graph and local graph
extras: Desktop-only; relies on internal graph renderer APIs that may change in future Obsidian versions. Mutually exclusive with other graph node-coloring schemes, including Obsidian's built-in Graph color groups; disabling the plugin restores original colors. Note the manifest description says nodes are colored by hop distance from the active note, while the README says coloring is by folder depth and independent of the active note.
intentEvidence: colors graph view nodes by their folder depth, as a gradient between two colors
problem: Obsidian's graph view colors nodes by groups or manual settings, not automatically by how deep a note sits in the folder tree.
summary: Graph coloring plugin that tints graph view nodes by folder depth as a gradient between two colors, applied per top-level folder section.
